authored_from: Articles (Serious)/technical/3B1B — Sustain - Formal Execution.md, §V (V — the viable region) and §VII (Control — Lyapunov distance to V); 3B1B — Monitor - Formal Execution.md, Additions (urgency is distance-to-V; the fit caveat)
note: SPEC vectors for V as a first-class region and urgency(s) = d(s,V). Authored from the articles, not generated from the reference engine.

divergence.statement: The reference engine has neither a region nor a distance. Its V is a flat list of boolean invariant expressions, and its urgency is a single ratio.

term_by_term.V as a region: RUST-AHEAD. The reference stores invariants as a list of strings and evaluates them to true/false. A list can only be true or false; it cannot be measured, projected, intersected or searched — which is why §V calls the upgrade 'the crux of the module' rather than cosmetic. There is no box of per-dimension intervals anywhere, so 'how far outside' has nothing to compute against.
term_by_term.urgency = d(s,V): RUST-AHEAD. The reference's urgency is `pct = spent / allocated` (curated_ui.urgency_for_pocket, identical to monitor.jsx's Slice 0 signal). It is a ratio on ONE hardcoded pair of fields, not a distance from a declared region — so it says nothing about a fridge temperature, a stock level, or any dimension that is not a pocket.
term_by_term.the allocated<=0 blind spot: A CONCRETE DEFECT the region form fixes: `if allocated <= 0: return 0.0`. A pocket with nothing allocated and money going out of it is reported as MAXIMALLY CALM. As a region it is simply outside V, by exactly the overspend.
term_by_term.declared weights w: RUST-AHEAD, and absent by construction: with no multi-dimensional distance there is nothing to weight. §VII is explicit that the relative-importance judgement across incommensurable units must be declared in the spec where it can be argued with, never buried in a norm.
term_by_term.three-valued membership + margin: RUST-AHEAD. The reference's invariants are boolean, so 'comfortably fine' and 'one bad week from not fine' are the same answer.

divergence.what_python_does_have_and_why_it_is_not_: The `pct` proxy is NOT arbitrary, and the reference is honest about what it is: curated_ui.py's own comment calls it 'the only real distance-to-viable-region metric this codebase has today' and says it deliberately reuses the Monitor's existing signal rather than inventing a second notion of 'important'. That discipline is right and is preserved here — this slice replaces the proxy with the real quantity, it does not add a competing one.
divergence.shared_limit_not_a_rust_shortfall: Neither engine can score a violated cross-dimension RELATION: a boolean has no natural distance. Rust names them instead, and marks `weighted` a lower bound when any is violated. Inventing a penalty number would fabricate the one signal the whole system is supposed to trust.
divergence.when_python_catches_up: These cases become parity vectors unchanged; nothing in them is Rust-specific.
divergence.not_a_divergence_in: R1 behaviour. The region is a new additive module and touches no existing gate path.

measure_cases.name: outside_the_region_the_distance_says_how_far
measure_cases.why: The crux of §V. A list of booleans can only say 'false'; a region says 250.

measure_cases.name: a_band_is_violated_from_below
measure_cases.why: A two-sided interval, not just a floor — `temperature ∈ [2,8]` is the article's own example.

measure_cases.name: a_band_is_violated_from_above
measure_cases.why: The other side of the same band.

measure_cases.name: a_dimension_that_is_not_a_number_is_refused
measure_cases.why: Fail loudly rather than treat an unreadable dimension as satisfied — the same rule the gate follows for an unparseable invariant.

projection_cases.name: the_binding_dimension_is_named
projection_cases.why: PROJECTED: which dimension is the binding one. Under equal weights the larger excess wins — 12 over a ceiling beats 10 under a floor.

projection_cases.name: the_declared_weights_change_which_dimension_binds
projection_cases.why: §VII's first warning, made operational: shillings and degrees are incommensurable, so the ranking IS a judgement. The same state has a different binding dimension once money is weighted 10× — which is exactly why the weights belong in the spec where they can be argued with.

projection_cases.name: an_undeclared_weight_is_reported_not_silently_defaulted
projection_cases.why: A relative-importance judgement being made by a default must be VISIBLE. The fallback exists so a region is usable before every weight is argued out, not so the judgement can be skipped.

relation_cases.name: a_violated_relation_is_named_not_scored
relation_cases.why: An interval violation has a natural distance; a boolean has none. Reporting a zero box distance as W = 0 would say 'in the viable region' about a state that is not — so `is_zero` requires BOTH halves and `weighted` is marked a lower bound.

relation_cases.name: w_is_zero_exactly_when_the_state_is_viable
relation_cases.why: W(s) = 0 ⟺ s ∈ V̄, checked in BOTH directions and including the case a box-only distance would get wrong.

relation_cases.name: an_unparseable_relation_refuses_rather_than_passing
relation_cases.why: Fail-safe defaults. A rule that cannot be read is not a rule that holds.

membership_cases.name: membership_distinguishes_the_boundary_from_the_interior
membership_cases.why: Inside V, W ≡ 0 and cannot rank anything — so the boundary has to be its own answer, or the margin has nowhere to live.

membership_cases.name: the_margin_distinguishes_comfortably_fine_from_one_bad_week_away
membership_cases.why: §VII's second warning. Both states are in V with W = 0; only the margin tells them apart. NOTE this is the BOX margin — the article's kernel_margin needs Viab_T(V) (§VI), which needs T and is not built. The box margin is an honest over-estimate of it, named as such.

membership_cases.name: there_is_no_margin_outside_the_region
membership_cases.why: Outside V the question is the distance back in, not the room left.

containment_cases.name: a_tighter_child_fits_inside_its_parent
containment_cases.why: INTERSECTED: does the child's region fit inside the parent's? Routine against a region, impossible against a list.

containment_cases.name: a_wider_child_does_not_and_the_dimension_is_named
containment_cases.why: A child that can be alive where its parent is not.

containment_cases.name: a_child_that_does_not_bound_a_parent_dimension_at_all_does_not_fit
containment_cases.why: Unbounded where the parent bounds is not containment — it is the absence of a bound.

containment_cases.name: containment_over_relations_is_provable_only_when_the_child_carries_them
containment_cases.why: Interval containment is decidable; an opaque predicate is not. Returning false rather than guessing keeps the answer honest — and the report says which relation is missing.

declaration_cases.name: an_empty_interval_is_rejected_at_authoring_time
declaration_cases.why: A region nothing can be inside is a load-time finding, not a 2 a.m. one.

declaration_cases.name: a_non_positive_weight_is_rejected
declaration_cases.why: A zero or negative weight silently deletes or inverts a dimension's contribution to the one signal everything else trusts.

replacement_cases.name: an_unfunded_pocket_can_be_urgent_which_the_pct_proxy_could_never_say
replacement_cases.why: The concrete payoff, and the defect it fixes. The reference returns 0.0 whenever `allocated <= 0`, so a pocket with nothing allocated and money going out of it is reported as MAXIMALLY CALM. As a region it is simply outside V, by exactly the overspend.
